Full-time Bricklayer (Blocklayer) position available with competitive salary. Work in a dynamic team in Carlisle WA 6101. 

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Full-Time Bricklayer (Blocklayer)
•	Salary Range: $75,000 - $95,000 per annum plus superannuation
•	Exciting opportunity to work in a professional setting.

About Us
Monolith Civil Australia is a premier civil construction and infrastructure contractor. We deliver large-scale commercial, industrial, and public infrastructure projects across Australia. We are committed to safety, structural integrity, and operational excellence. Our teams work on complex civil engineering projects requiring high-quality masonry, blockwork, and structural bricklaying.

About the role
The Bricklayer (Blocklayer) is responsible for constructing, repairing, and maintaining brick, block, and stone structures across various civil construction sites. This role requires precision in laying materials for retaining walls, structural foundations, and infrastructure components. The successful candidate will interpret architectural plans, calculate material requirements, and execute masonry work to strict Australian Standards and project specifications.

Duties and Responsibilities

•	Study blueprints, civil engineering drawings, and specifications to determine material requirements, dimensions, and installation procedures.
•	Seal foundations with damp-resistant materials to prevent moisture ingress.
•	Prepare mortar mixtures to correct consistencies and spread mortar accurately for structural integrity.
•	Lay bricks, stone, structural tiles, and heavy concrete building blocks in specified rows, designs, and shapes.
•	Check the vertical and horizontal alignment of structures continuously using plumb bobs, spirit levels, and laser levels.
•	Cut, shape, and polish stones, bricks, and blocks using specialized masonry saws and hand tools to fit custom spaces.
•	Build retaining walls, structural pillars, manholes, and other masonry components required for civil infrastructure projects.
•	Repair and maintain existing brick, cement block, and related masonry structures on site.
•	Comply with all Monolith Civil Australia Work Health and Safety (WHS) policies and procedures.
•	Erect and dismantle scaffolding safely to facilitate masonry work at heights.
•	Identify and report site hazards, near misses, and incidents to the Site Supervisor immediately.
•	Ensure all masonry work complies with the Building Code of Australia (BCA) and relevant structural engineering standards.

Essential Skills

•	Advanced ability to read and interpret complex civil construction plans and structural diagrams.
•	Strong spatial awareness and ability to calculate material quantities accurately.
•	High level of physical fitness and stamina to perform manual labour, lift heavy materials, and work in various weather conditions.
•	Exceptional precision in alignment, leveling, and finishing of masonry structures.

Qualifications needed:

•	Minimum Trade qualification certificate or equivalent relevant work experience
•	Minimum one year of work experience on relevant position
•	White card
•	Driver’s License

What We Offer

•	Competitive salary based on experience
•	Opportunities for professional growth and training
•	A supportive and dynamic work environment
•	Work on exciting projects with cutting-edge technology

Salary:  The role offers a remuneration package ranging from $75,000-$95,000 plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

How to Apply: 11 Recruitment is your pathway to securing this exciting opportunity. We are looking forward to facilitating your application and potentially welcoming you to a company that values expertise. Apply now and let us help you take the next step in your career.

- Plan, develop, and maintain customer access telecommunications network infrastructure to support organisational growth and service delivery objectives

## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline
